name: blackraptor
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. Governed AI agent teams for Claude Code — a software-engineering team and an executive advisory council, plus a shared Core pack of cross-cutting agents (product-manager, evidence-auditor) and skills (Excellence Pass, research-integrity, gate reviews). Install any team; the Core pack comes with it — plus the full-stack marketing team and the hardware-engineering team, all served through this marketplace.

plugins.name: blackraptor-engineering
plugins.description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A governed software-engineering team (architect, engineers, blocking-gate reviewers) routed by the process-only main-session engineering skill, plus shared skills. Auto-installs blackraptor-core (product-manager + evidence-auditor + research-integrity).

plugins.name: blackraptor-council
plugins.description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A 12-seat executive advisory council runs the challenge protocol. Eight seats answer to conventional C-suite names: COO, CFO, CRO, CHRO, CTO, General Counsel, and two CMO seats. A ninth, the Chair / Chief of Staff, runs the convening. They convene through the main-session council skill, anchored by the shared product-manager (CPO), auto-installed with blackraptor-core. The chair closes the convening with one decision. There is no CEO seat: you are the CEO.

plugins.name: blackraptor-marketing
plugins.description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A governed, full-stack marketing department (brand, naming/trademark, research, content, copy, creative, SEO/GEO, paid, social, email, video, competitive intel, pricing, analytics, campaign coordinator) + the compliance-claims-gate every external asset passes through. Auto-installs blackraptor-core. No autonomous sends, posts, or spend — agents draft, humans approve. Hosted in BlackRaptorAI/BlackRaptor_Agents_Marketing.

plugins.name: blackraptor-hardware
plugins.description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A governed hardware-engineering department + an adversarial design-review gate, conducted by the main-session hw-program skill (decision register, interfaces, PDR/CDR/MRR readiness). Ships the hw-operating-standard skill. Product-agnostic via per-program PROGRAM-CONTEXT.md. Auto-installs blackraptor-core. Agents design and analyze — humans make the irreversible calls. Hosted in BlackRaptorAI/BlackRaptor_Agents_HW_Engineering.

plugins.name: blackraptor-core
plugins.description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. Cross-cutting agents shared by every team: product-manager and evidence-auditor, plus the research-integrity skill. Auto-installed as a dependency of all four packs — not installed directly.
